prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
Summary of the Green Party Manifesto 2024 (policy measures only)

Health and social care
- NHS: Extra revenue funding rising from £8bn (year 1) to £28bn by 2030; at least £20bn capital over five years. Rapid GP access, same-day urgent GP, guaranteed NHS dentistry. Public health budgets restored (+£1.5bn). Primary care: +£1.5bn/year by 2030 and £2bn capital. Dentistry: +£3bn/year by 2030 and community prevention hubs. National Cancer Plan; mental health access to therapies within 28 days; school/college counsellors. Support junior doctor pay restoration. Assisted dying legislation. End new HIV cases by 2030.
- Social care: Free personal care; £20bn/year; national pay/career structure for carers; anti-exploitation reforms for overseas care workers. Disabled people: +5% to disability benefits; oppose PIP vouchers; free SEND transport 16–18; workplace adjustments. Children’s social care: +£3bn to councils; longer “staying put” support.

Housing and planning
- 150,000 new social homes/year; end Right to Buy; empower rent controls; end no-fault evictions. Retrofit and resilience: £29bn home insulation (5 years), £4bn for public buildings, £9bn low‑carbon heating, £7bn heat adaptation; area-based local delivery. New builds to Passivhaus/equivalent, solar and heat pumps; minimum EPC C. Bring empty homes into use; first-refusal powers for councils on certain properties.

Energy and climate
- No new oil/gas; carbon tax escalating over a decade; end fossil subsidies. Wind ~70% of electricity by 2030; targets by 2035: 80GW offshore wind, 53GW onshore, 100GW solar; end de-facto ban on onshore wind. Expand grid, interconnectors, storage; green hydrogen for industry. Community ownership thresholds. Stop new nuclear and phase out existing over time.

Economy, industry, and utilities
- Average £40bn/year green investment (parliament), incl. energy systems, retrofits, rail, public transport, active travel, industry decarbonisation, water/sewage; nationalise water, rail, and Big 5 retail energy companies. Bank/finance mandates to exit fossil assets by 2030; BoE mandate includes transition; credit guidance. Regional mutual banks; £2bn/year local grants to help SMEs decarbonise; Prompt Payment Code in law.

Work and incomes
- Repeal recent anti-union laws; Charter of Workers’ Rights. Minimum wage £15/hour for all ages (offset for small firms via Employment Allowance to £10k). 10:1 pay ratio cap. Day‑one rights; equal pay audits; platform workers classed as “workers.”

Welfare and tax
- UC/legacy +£40/week; scrap five-week wait and two-child cap; disability benefits +5%; carers’ allowance +10%/month; uprate pensions with inflation and wages; scrap bedroom tax; end sanctions; long-term aim: UBI.
- Tax: Wealth tax (1% >£10m; 2% >£1bn). Align CGT and investment income rates with earned income; remove NI upper limit; standardise pension tax relief at basic rate; reform inheritance tax. Carbon tax starting £120/tCO2e, rising towards £500 within 10 years. Higher windfall taxes; VAT cuts for hospitality/arts, higher VAT for financial services and private education. Borrow to invest.

Nature, food, and animals
- Rights of Nature Act; 30% land/sea protected by 2030; water companies into public ownership; +£1.5bn to DEFRA; Clean Air Act; Right to Roam; peatland rewetting; woodland +50%; £3bn/year for nature restoration. Ban destructive fishing in MPAs. Commission on Animal Protection; ban blood sports; end factory farming practices (cages, routine antibiotics); oppose badger cull; ban snares/lead ammo; reduce/replace animal testing.

Education
- End tuition fees; restore maintenance grants; consider graduate debt cancellation long term. Sure Start +£1.4bn/year; childcare 35 hours/week from 9 months (subject to sector agreement). Schools: +£8bn (incl. £2bn teacher pay); £2.5bn/year for safe buildings (RAAC). End high-stakes testing and Ofsted; bring academies into LA control; VAT and remove charitable status for private schools (SEND exempt). SEND +£5bn; school nurses and counsellors. Post‑16: £3bn for sixth form; FE skills +£12bn; restore EMA.

Transport
- Raise rail/bus subsidies to £10bn/year; £19bn over five years for public transport, electrification, cycling/walking; rail nationalisation; local control of buses; £2.5bn/year for cycleways/footpaths. Oppose new road building; restore fuel duty escalator; road pricing. EV transition: end new ICE sales by 2027; end road use of ICE by 2035; scrappage up to £5bn/year; vehicle tax by weight; default 20mph in built-up areas; more rail freight. Aviation: frequent-flyer levy; ban domestic flights with <3-hour rail alternatives; tax kerosene via carbon tax; no airport expansion; worker transition support.

Democracy, rights, migration, and justice
- Fair Politics Act (proportional representation, repeal voter ID, party finance transparency, stronger lobbying rules, votes at 16). Replace House of Lords with elected chamber; devolution enhancements; +£5bn/year to English local government. Protect HRA/ECHR; restore legal aid; repeal protest-curbing laws; self-ID for trans people; X passport option.
- Migration: end “hostile environment”; safe routes; faster asylum; right to work while awaiting decision; end NRPF and 10‑year route; limit detention to public-safety cases; voting rights for visa-holders; new Department of Migration; fees at cost; NHS access for visa‑holders; family reunion rights.
- Justice/policing: Invest ~£11bn over parliament in MoJ; repair courts; recruit judges. End routine stop-and-search and facial recognition; make misogyny a hate crime; decriminalise sex work; presumption against custodial sentences <2 years; expand diversion; drug law reform with decriminalised personal possession.

Foreign and security
- Support Ukraine; strengthen international law. Long-term aim to rejoin EU (customs union first, restore free movement, Erasmus). Aid to 1% GNI by 2033; climate finance to 1.5% GNI incl. Loss & Damage. End ISDS in trade deals. Sign TPNW; cancel Trident; promote NATO reforms (No First Use, defensive posture). Israel–Palestine: immediate permanent ceasefire, recognise Palestine, end UK arms exports to Israel, war‑crimes accountability.
